_meta.purpose: Page grammar for an operational dashboard: ONE working Section (the bento work area) holding a header row, optional overview figures, optional controls, then one or more panel rows.
_meta.bento: The reference dashboards are exactly [Header, Section]. The slots below are ROWS INSIDE that single Section — they are NOT separate Sections. Stack them in one ContainerVertical at gap "md"; see pageTypeSpecific.frame for the skeleton.

header.note: Exactly one page header row, the first row inside the Section. It carries the page title and the page-level actions.

overview.note: Headline figures before the detail. Omit when the request has no measurable values.

controls.note: Only when a table or list panel follows that the user must narrow down.

content.note: The working area. Mix panel types — a page of identical rows is a mono-layout and fails the composition rules.

pageTypeSpecific.frame: ONE Section only. plan.layout = [ Header, { type: "Section", fills: "color.background.canvas", spacing: "small", contentWidth: "(Def) Full", children: [ { type: "ContainerVertical", gap: "md", children: [ ...the ordered slot rows... ] } ] } ]. The Section carries NO title — panels own their own h4 title. Set plan.pageType = "dashboard" so the audit enforces the single-Section bento.
pageTypeSpecific.spacingLadder: Measured from the canonical catalog cards: card padding 12px (Card spacing "small") WITH a 12px content gap, panels/cards to each other 16px. So R = sm (elements in a card, card padding), R−1 = xs (grouped: title+description, label+value), R−2 = 2xs (tight inline pairs), R+1 = md (panel rows and grid gaps).

rules: A dashboard is ONE Section — a bento grid of self-titled panels on one canvas background, never a stack of titled zebra sections.
Dashboards are data-first and dense: Section spacing "small", Card spacing "small" (12px) with a matching "sm" content gap.
A card's content gap must never exceed the card's padding: "small" (12px) pairs with gap "sm", "medium" (16px) with gap "md". A 16px gap in a 12px card is a defect.
Graphs always span the full width available to them: every ChartBar is fillWidth inside fill-width column containers, never a fixed bar width.
An icon-only Button MUST carry a verified icon. Without one it renders the library's "<Icon>" placeholder as an empty ✕ box — then use a labelled Button instead.
Equal columns in a data row come from a ContainerHorizontal of fill-width children, never from a Grid. The Grid has no five-column variant.
A Grid child count must not exceed its layout's slot count: 3 for (Def) 33-33-33, 4 for 25-25-25-25, 2 for the two-column layouts, 1 for 100.
Rows inside a panel are separated by a weak Divider, not by extra gap.
At most one Brand action on the page — it belongs to the page header row. Everything else is Filled, ghost or a Link.

Active filters are removable Tags with WEAK emphasis — they report the current state and must not compete with the page actions. A Badge is a non-interactive status label and must never stand in for a filter.
A search field carries the magnifier as a LEADING icon (iconLeading: "magnifying_glass"); that is what distinguishes it from a plain text field.

A table's header row has exactly as many cells as its data rows and every cell FILLS — the leading Checkbox cell included — so each value sits under its own header. Pagination under a panel is centered.
Determinate progress uses the real DB progress component, which offers only 25, 50 and 75 percent. Any other value is a hard stop — never draw a bar.
Chart bars are the ChartBar primitive with a registered fill token; never an image and never a free-form vector.
Heterogeneous content needs different panel types; use the bento row for panels of unequal weight.
